name: Railway cloud platform landing page by railway.com
description: A near-black, long-scroll landing page that pairs an editorial serif display face with monospace UI labels, set against a vaporwave illustrated hero (starry sky, gradient mountains, train). The page runs on a repeating 'chapter' skeleton — monospace eyebrow tag, serif heading, one-line support copy with a Learn more arrow, a large product screenshot, a 3-up blurb row, and an 'Alternative to' competitor icon row — so rhythm comes from repetition while section backgrounds subtly shift tint (deep green for observability, deep purple elsewhere) to mark transitions. Dense, hairline-bordered logo wall and monospace flip-counter stats provide contrast to the airy feature sections, with purple reserved almost exclusively for the primary CTA and green for status/success states.
